newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Sporitelna gives 96 results March 27.
newsitem.headline: Czech Sporitelna gives 96 results March 27.

text.p: Ceska Sporitelna a.s., the laregst Czech savings bank, on Thursday said it would hold a news conference at 1030 local time (0930 GMT) on March 27 to detail its financial results for 1996.

According to filings with the Prague Stock Exchange (PSE) made at the end of February, the bank posted a preliminary net profit of 1.85 billion crowns, according to Czech accounting standards, after 263 million in 1995.
The bank's gross profit was also 1.85 billion as the bank said it planned to pay no income tax.
Sporitelna's 1995 gross profit was 9.17 billion crowns but the bank assigned 9.13 billion to its reserves covering "classified" loans where recovery is seen as doubtful at best.
The PSE said the bank's total assets at the end of 1996 were 359.7 billion crowns, down from 367.85 billion at the end of the previous year.
